answer: Stop sybils with a signal anchor island: an agent stakes a bond for one island anchor. Each cycle it sends a signal and files its anchor log; verifiers match the signal's echo to the anchor chain, voiding an island whose signal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 islands at 18x: each signal fits one island and one anchor, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents signal once and keep rights.
